signal: Xoxoday raised a Series C in January 2026 (Apis Partners, 57 Stars) to accelerate global expansion ahead of a potential IPO.

email.body1:
Abhimanyu, saw Xoxoday closed its Series C to push global expansion ahead of a potential IPO.

Expanding into new regions usually means far more in-market accounts than the team can cover before headcount catches up, and that is where revenue slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Xoxoday off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Abhimanyu, quick follow-up for Xoxoday.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline tend to jump faster than you can ramp reps across nine offices. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Xoxoday needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Abhimanyu, last bit of proof for Xoxoday.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Xoxoday's reply rate likely compares to peers scaling globally. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Abhimanyu, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while you push the global expansion, no problem at all. Timing matters right after a raise, and I know the post-Series-C stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a multi-region motion? I will tailor it to Xoxoday either way.
